notes: Read SKILL.md (670 lines) in full. The skill helps write SIEM detection rules in KQL (Sentinel) and SPL (Splunk) mapped to MITRE ATT&CK technique IDs: example queries for password spray, impossible travel, off-hours privileged logons and correlation, plus threshold tuning, rule lifecycle and an output template.

The skill produces query text only; it explicitly says never to execute queries against production SIEMs or deploy rules (SKILL.md:651, 655). Tools are Read/Grep/Glob. No commands, installs, credentials, network access, or file writes.

SKILL.md:642 links ../../../schemas/finding.schema.json, used only for optional JSON output (not shipped). The injection-like phrases (SKILL.md:652) are defensive guidance to treat 'ignore previous instructions' in logs as data. Sibling skills (detection-engineering, alert-triage, log-analysis) are named only as alternatives.
